Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Naira - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Meenakshi - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Rajesh - 39 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Zoya - 11 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Naira, Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Naira, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan puts on his school uniform.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "Exactly right."

[Ayaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Meenakshi: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Rajesh: "What next?"

[Naira applies kajal to her eyes.]

Naira: "How beautiful!"

[Naira puts on red lipstick.]

Naira (softly): "What happened?"

[Naira puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Rajesh: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan starts crying.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Meenakshi: "Show me too!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Ayaan (laughing): "Really?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ayaan (happily): "Dad, are you okay?"

[Ayaan swings on the swing.]

Meenakshi: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Ayaan: "Exactly right."

Scene 4: The road - Day

Naira: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan (excited): "Dad, listen!"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Ayaan: "Really?"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Ayaan: "Let's see."

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan: "I knew it!"

[Ayaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Rajesh: "That was such a fun day!"
